keywords.text: 電池 (battery) mentioned — remove batteries before posting; lithium batteries are restricted in air mail.

Food — import rules vary widely by country. Avoid.
Cosmetics — ingredient and import rules vary. Avoid.
Swords / replica swords — export and import heavily restricted.
Japanese 100V adapter included — mention voltage in your listing.
限定 (limited edition) — check eBay sold prices; limited runs can sell well above normal.
